<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>SIGNAL // INDIC — Speech LLM Latency Lab</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #0a0e1a;
    --surface: #111827;
    --border: #1e2636;
    --cyan: #00e5ff;
    --lime: #b3ff00;
    --vio: #cc44ff;
    --grey: #8892a4;
    --wht: #e8edf5;
    --red: #ff4d6d;
  }
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body {
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--wht);
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    line-height: 1.6;
    padding: env(safe-area-inset-top,0) env(safe-area-inset-right,0) env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0) env(safe-area-inset-left,0);
  }
  a { color: var(--cyan); text-decoration: none; }
  a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

  /* layout */
  .wrap { max-width: 980px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px 60px; }

  /* hero */
  .hero { text-align: center; padding: 40px 0 32px; }
  .hero img { width: 100%; max-width: 900px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .hero-tagline { font-size: 13px; color: var(--grey); margin-top: 14px; letter-spacing: 2px; }

  /* badges row */
  .badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; margin: 16px 0 8px; }
  .badge {
    display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 1px; border: 1px solid;
  }
  .badge-cyan  { color: var(--cyan); border-color: var(--cyan); }
  .badge-lime  { color: var(--lime); border-color: var(--lime); }
  .badge-vio   { color: var(--vio);  border-color: var(--vio);  }
  .badge-grey  { color: var(--grey); border-color: var(--border); }

  /* section headers */
  .section { margin-top: 52px; }
  .section-label {
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 3px; color: var(--cyan);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  /* dashboard grid */
  .dashboard { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr; gap: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
  .dash-row { display: contents; }
  .dash-row:not(:last-child) .dk, .dash-row:not(:last-child) .dv { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .dk { background: var(--surface); padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--grey); letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .dv { padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--wht); }

  /* research question */
  .rq {
    background: var(--surface); border-left: 3px solid var(--cyan);
    padding: 18px 22px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
    font-size: 15px; color: var(--wht); line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* arch cards */
  .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin-top: 20px; }
  @media(max-width:640px) { .cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .card {
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px; position: relative;
  }
  .card-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .card-sub { font-size: 10px; color: var(--grey); letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .card-body { font-size: 12px; color: var(--grey); line-height: 1.6; font-family: sans-serif; }
  .card-cyan  { border-top: 2px solid var(--cyan); } .card-cyan .card-title { color: var(--cyan); }
  .card-vio   { border-top: 2px solid var(--vio);  } .card-vio .card-title  { color: var(--vio); }
  .card-lime  { border-top: 2px solid var(--lime); } .card-lime .card-title { color: var(--lime); }

  /* comparison table */
  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 16px; font-size: 12px; }
  th { background: var(--surface); color: var(--grey); font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: 1px;
       padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  td { padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--wht); }
  tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  .hi { color: var(--cyan); font-weight: bold; }
  .good { color: var(--lime); font-weight: bold; }

  /* charts */
  .charts-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-top: 16px; }
  @media(max-width:640px) { .charts-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .chart-wrap { text-align: center; }
  .chart-wrap img { width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .chart-caption { font-size: 10px; color: var(--grey); margin-top: 8px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .chart-full { text-align: center; margin-top: 16px; }
  .chart-full img { width: 100%; max-width: 520px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); }

  /* observation box */
  .obs {
    background: #0d1829; border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--lime); border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
    padding: 14px 18px; margin-top: 20px; font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--grey); font-family: sans-serif; line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .obs strong { color: var(--wht); }

  /* pipeline svg */
  .pipeline { margin-top: 16px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
  .pipeline svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }

  /* reproduce steps */
  .steps { counter-reset: step; margin-top: 16px; }
  .step { display: flex; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .step-num {
    counter-increment: step;
    min-width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--cyan);
    color: var(--cyan); font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .step-body { font-size: 13px; color: var(--grey); font-family: sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; padding-top: 4px; }
  .step-body strong { color: var(--wht); }

  /* colab button */
  .colab-btn {
    display: inline-block; background: #F9AB00; color: #000;
    padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px;
    margin-top: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px;
  }
  .colab-btn:hover { background: #ffbf00; text-decoration: none; }

  /* limitations */
  .limits { list-style: none; margin-top: 12px; }
  .limits li { padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 12px; color: var(--grey); font-family: sans-serif; }
  .limits li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .limits li::before { content: "↳ "; color: var(--vio); }

  /* footer */
  .footer {
    text-align: center; margin-top: 60px; padding-top: 24px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 11px; color: var(--grey);
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }
  .footer a { color: var(--cyan); }

  /* divider */
  hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); margin: 0; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

  <!-- ── HERO ── -->
  <div class="hero">
    <img src="data:image/gif;base64," alt="SIGNAL // INDIC animated banner"/>
    <p class="hero-tagline">SPEECH INTELLIGENCE &nbsp;·&nbsp; LATENCY LAB &nbsp;·&nbsp; HINDI // KANNADA</p>
    <div class="badges" style="margin-top:18px;">
      <span class="badge badge-cyan">PYTHON 3.10+</span>
      <span class="badge badge-cyan">JUPYTER</span>
      <span class="badge badge-lime">WHISPER</span>
      <span class="badge badge-lime">FLEURS</span>
      <span class="badge badge-vio">EXPERIMENTAL</span>
      <a href="https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1GqasiGGlLbPUYyKf6NDzyu1l1kQ9VLwr?usp=sharing" class="badge badge-cyan">▶ OPEN IN COLAB</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── DASHBOARD ── -->
  <div class="section">
    <div class="section-label">🗂️ &nbsp;RESEARCH DASHBOARD</div>
    <div class="dashboard">
      <div class="dash-row"><div class="dk">TOPIC</div><div class="dv">Speech LLM latency · multilingual ASR · turn-taking architecture</div></div>
      <div class="dash-row"><div class="dk">LANGUAGES</div><div class="dv">🇮🇳 Hindi (hi_in) &nbsp;·&nbsp; 🇮🇳 Kannada (kn_in)</div></div>
      <div class="dash-row"><div class="dk">TEST SET</div><div class="dv">100 utterances — FLEURS test split (50 Hindi + 50 Kannada)</div></div>
      <div class="dash-row"><div class="dk">BASELINE</div><div class="dv">openai/whisper-small · language-prompted decoding</div></div>
      <div class="dash-row"><div class="dk">SPECIALIST</div><div class="dv">vasista22/whisper-hindi-large-v2 &nbsp;·&nbsp; vasista22/whisper-kannada-medium</div></div>
      <div class="dash-row"><div class="dk">METRICS</div><div class="dv">WER · CER · Mean latency · P95 latency · RTF</div></div>
      <div class="dash-row"><div class="dk">STATUS</div><div class="dv" style="color:var(--lime);">[ EXPERIMENTS COMPLETE ] &nbsp;&nbsp; Controller: unit-tested prototype</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── RESEARCH QUESTION ── -->
  <div class="section">
    <div class="section-label">🔬 &nbsp;RESEARCH QUESTION</div>
    <div class="rq">
      What architectural limitations prevent Speech LLMs from achieving low-latency, natural, real-time conversations?
    </div>
    <div class="cards">
      <div class="card card-cyan">
        <div class="card-title">MOSHI</div>
        <div class="card-sub">~200 ms reported latency</div>
        <div class="card-body">Joint codec-based speech + text modelling. Audio tokens (8 RVQ codebooks via Mimi) inject directly into a hierarchical Temporal+Depth Transformer. Turn-taking emerges from learned joint audio behaviour — no explicit state tokens. Requires 7M+ hours of training audio.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card card-grey" style="border-top: 2px solid var(--grey);">
        <div class="card-title" style="color:var(--wht);">SALMONN-omni</div>
        <div class="card-sub">405 ms avg TTFA reported</div>
        <div class="card-body">No audio codec tokens in the LLM. A Mamba streaming encoder feeds Llama-3-8B-Instruct via MLP adapter. CosyVoice2 handles synthesis. Explicit &lt;think&gt; / &lt;shift&gt; tokens control turn transitions — interpretable but adds structural latency.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card card-vio">
        <div class="card-title">OUR PROPOSAL</div>
        <div class="card-sub">Research hypothesis</div>
        <div class="card-body">Adaptive controller conditioned on acoustic context <strong style="color:var(--vio)">xₜ</strong>, semantic-completeness confidence <strong style="color:var(--vio)">cₜ</strong>, and latency budget <strong style="color:var(--vio)">bₜ</strong>. Four actions: respond · keep listening · continue speaking · yield. All 7 synthetic unit tests pass.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table style="margin-top:24px;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>DIMENSION</th>
          <th>MOSHI</th>
          <th>SALMONN-OMNI</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>Speech encoder</td><td>Mimi codec — 12.5 Hz, 8 RVQ codebooks</td><td>Mamba streaming — 25 Hz, distilled from Whisper-large-v3</td></tr>
        <tr><td>LLM alignment</td><td>Direct token injection, joint training</td><td>MLP adapter + LoRA rank 32</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Turn-taking</td><td>Emergent from audio modelling</td><td>Explicit &lt;think&gt; / &lt;shift&gt; tokens</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Reported latency</td><td class="hi">~200 ms (paper setup)</td><td>~405 ms avg TTFA (paper setup)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Training audio</td><td>7M+ hours</td><td>~730k ASR + ~80k dialogue samples</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <p style="font-size:10px;color:var(--grey);margin-top:8px;font-family:sans-serif;">These latency figures use different evaluation setups — not a direct head-to-head comparison.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- ── PIPELINE ── -->
  <div class="section">
    <div class="section-label">🏗️ &nbsp;SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE</div>
    <div class="pipeline">

        <text x="905" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#4b5563">WER 0.066 Kannada</text>

    <table style="margin-top:24px;">
      <thead>
        <tr><th>LANGUAGE</th><th>CONDITION</th><th>WER</th><th>CER</th><th>MEAN LATENCY</th><th>RTF</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>Hindi</td><td style="color:var(--grey)">Whisper-small baseline</td><td>0.530</td><td>0.360</td><td>2.5 s</td><td>0.24</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Hindi</td><td class="good">Specialist (large-v2)</td><td class="good">0.040</td><td class="good">0.020</td><td>21.1 s</td><td>1.97</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Kannada</td><td style="color:var(--grey)">Whisper-small baseline</td><td>2.057</td><td>1.335</td><td>7.6 s</td><td>0.69</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Kannada</td><td class="good">Specialist (medium)</td><td class="good">0.066</td><td class="good">0.037</td><td>23.1 s</td><td>1.86</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="obs">
      <strong>Accuracy vs latency trade-off.</strong> Specialist models cut WER by ~13× for Hindi and ~31× for Kannada. The cost is a ~10× latency increase because the specialist models are substantially larger. The Whisper-small Kannada baseline also showed severe hallucination (repeated syllable loops like <em>ಸಾರಿಲಿಲಿಲಿ...</em>), a known failure mode on lower-resource languages with the small multilingual model. In a real-time system these larger models would need quantisation, batching, or GPU acceleration to be viable.
    </div>

    <ul class="limits">
      <li>Evaluation uses FLEURS test split — read speech in clean conditions. Spontaneous or noisy speech will perform differently.</li>
      <li>Accuracy and latency must be read together. Specialist models are not real-time (RTF &gt; 1) without hardware acceleration.</li>
      <li>Moshi (~200 ms) and SALMONN-omni (~405 ms) latency figures come from different evaluation setups in their respective papers — not a direct speed ranking.</li>
      <li>The proposed turn-transition controller passes 7 synthetic unit tests. It has not been evaluated end-to-end against real conversational data.</li>
